text: {"lessons":["My account has declined about 13% from Period 1, so I should review portfolio-wide risk and diversification rather than focus only on individual holdings.","Selling Stock B at a steep loss reinforced that average cost is not a reason to hold or sell; I should judge each position by its current prospects and role in the portfolio.","I have traded rarely, which helps avoid unnecessary activity, but I should review the account periodically and make deliberate decisions rather than let inaction become neglect."]}
